**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Filter legacy rows from ADMIN image links**

When `MEDIA_STRATEGY` is `D1_BLOB` and a listing contains a preserved `listing_images` row with `blob_data IS NULL`, `GET /admin/listings/:id` and a successful rejection response still advertise an image URL because this query selects every stored row; following that URL reaches the D1 image handler and returns 503. Fresh evidence after the prior image-state fix is the missing `blob_data IS NOT NULL` predicate here, whereas the review queue already filters these rows and exposes `requiresMediaRecovery`; make the detail/mutation DTO follow the same contract instead of returning an unreadable link.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L43-L43](https://github.com/sjo1848/alquileres-uspa-cloudflare/blob/9a2351711d99345c0bcaa19d46b1e3415bc46c08/AGENTS.md#L43-L43)
